bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (localization only, no text translation); springboard/ui/src/format.rs (formatters only); springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (spelling only)
summary: Apple's Translation framework translates text between a language pair on device, through a system translation popover, a session API and language-availability checks. BifrOSt has no text-to-text translation API for apps and no translation UI. Its locale and spellcheck code only localize strings, format numbers and dates, and check spelling in the same language.

features.note: no SDK popover that translates a selection in place; the triage pointer to springboard/src/shell/browser/ is wrong, those hits are geometric translate() transforms in tiles.rs and values.rs, not text translation

gaps: No on-device text translation between language pairs for apps (no TranslationSession equivalent).
No system translation popover or inline translate action for selected text.
No language-pair availability or download-status query (LanguageAvailability).
Locale data covers only en and is, so even the related localization layer lacks the language pairs a translation feature would need (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Locale gaps).
